mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalExceptions, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = '待整改') AS pendingCount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = '整改中') AS inProgressCount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = '待验证') AS pendingVerifyCount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = '已闭环') AS closedCount, ROUND( CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = '已闭环') * 100.0 / COUNT(*) END, 2 ) AS closureRate, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE deadline < CURRENT_DATE AND status != '已闭环') AS overdueCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qms.escalation WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND plant_code = #{plantCode} AND status = 'ACTIVE') AS escalationCount FROM qms.exception_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND plant_code = #{plantCode}
SELECT severity AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM qms.exception_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND plant_code = #{plantCode} GROUP BY severity ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT source_type AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM qms.exception_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND plant_code = #{plantCode} GROUP BY source_type ORDER BY count DESC

choose.when: SELECT defect_desc AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM qms.exception_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND plant_code = #{plantCode} GROUP BY defect_desc ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT COALESCE(s.supplier_name, '未关联') AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM qms.exception_order e LEFT JOIN qms.supplier s ON e.supplier_id = s.id AND (s.is_deleted = 0 OR s.is_deleted IS NULL) WHERE e.is_deleted = 0 AND e.plant_code = #{plantCode} GROUP BY s.supplier_name ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT COALESCE(material_code, '未指定') AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM qms.exception_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND plant_code = #{plantCode} GROUP BY material_code ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM qms.exception_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND plant_code = #{plantCode} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY name
choose.otherwise: SELECT defect_desc AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM qms.exception_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND plant_code = #{plantCode} GROUP BY defect_desc ORDER BY count DESC

mapper.select: SELECT MAX(s.id) AS supplierId, MAX(m.supplier_name) AS supplierName, m.supplier_code AS supplierCode, m.material_code AS materialCode, MAX(m.defect_desc) AS defectDesc, COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) AS repeatCount, string_agg(DISTINCT e.id::text, ',') FILTER (WHERE e.id IS NOT NULL) AS relatedExceptionIdsStr FROM qms.material_inspection m INNER JOIN qms.supplier s ON s.supplier_code = m.supplier_code AND s.plant_code = m.plant_code AND s.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN qms.exception_order e ON e.source_type = '来料不良' AND e.source_id = m.id AND e.is_deleted = 0 WHERE m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.plant_code = #{plantCode} AND m.inspection_result = '不合格' AND m.supplier_code IS NOT NULL AND m.material_code IS NOT NULL AND m.inspection_date >= CURRENT_DATE - (#{daysWindow} - 1) AND m.inspection_date <= CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY m.supplier_code, m.material_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) >= #{minRepeatCount} ORDER BY repeatCount DESC

SELECT s.id AS supplierId, s.supplier_name AS supplierName, s.supplier_code AS supplierCode, COUNT(*) AS occurrenceCount, MAX(TO_CHAR(e.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS latestOccurrenceAt, (SELECT inner_e.defect_desc FROM qms.exception_order inner_e WHERE inner_e.is_deleted = 0 AND inner_e.supplier_id = s.id AND inner_e.source_type = '来料不良' AND inner_e.plant_code = #{plantCode}
AND inner_e.created_at >= #{startDate}::timestamp
AND inner_e.created_at <= #{endDate}::timestamp + interval '1 day'
GROUP BY inner_e.defect_desc ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) AS topDefectDesc, string_agg(e.id::text, ',' ORDER BY e.created_at DESC) AS relatedExceptionIdsStr FROM qms.exception_order e LEFT JOIN qms.supplier s ON e.supplier_id = s.id AND (s.is_deleted = 0 OR s.is_deleted IS NULL) WHERE e.is_deleted = 0 AND e.plant_code = #{plantCode} AND e.source_type = '来料不良'
AND e.supplier_id = #{supplierId}
AND e.created_at >= #{startDate}::timestamp
AND e.created_at <= #{endDate}::timestamp + interval '1 day'
GROUP BY s.id, s.supplier_name, s.supplier_code HAVING COUNT(*) >= COALESCE(#{minCount}, 1) ORDER BY occurrenceCount DESC, s.supplier_name
SELECT exception_no FROM qms.exception_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND exception_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%') ORDER BY exception_no DESC LIMIT 1
